newsitem.title: UK: Iran says oil demand fell to 1.23 mbpd in 1995 - IEA.
newsitem.headline: Iran says oil demand fell to 1.23 mbpd in 1995 - IEA.

text.p: Iranian domestic oil demand in 1995 fell by 3.4 percent to 1.23 million barrels per day (bpd), the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Friday.
Citing data received from the Iranian government, the Paris-based agency said the lower consumption reflected a combination of increased substitution of oil products by natural gas and higher taxes.
Oil use declined in all sectors of the Iranian economy except in the industrial and transport sectors.
Total energy demand in Iran rose by 1.5 percent but oil's share declined by four percent to 59 percent, the IEA said in its monthly oil market report.
The decline in oil use was most marked in the residential and commercial sector where gas use grew by 12.9 percent and gas' market share increased from 29 percent to 33 percent.
